source.miss_counter: n_notdirty_inline_miss counts all C-leaf declines, including policy/precondition, changed TLB tag, slow flags, CODE dirty, missing page, busy trylock, absent bitmap/translated blocks and real code overlap. It is not specifically contention or code overlap.
source.uncounted_bypass: Emitted exact-tag/alignment prechecks can bypass the leaf. Those return zero to the original helper without incrementing n_notdirty_inline_miss.
source.bounded_work: Page trylock does not wait; no bitmap creation or code invalidation in leaf. Aligned1/2/4-byte admission tests only a bounded bitmap range. Original fallback remains authoritative.
source.success_cost: Every successful admission also takes the page trylock, checks the bitmap and marks the unchanged dirty clients. Low decline counts do NOT rule out overall lock/bitmap/probe cost.
source.generated_code: Opt-in adds a conditional probe/import in store-TLB-miss arms. Ordinary RAM-hit path instructions and the existing one resumable block per store remain unchanged, but module size/CFG/register allocation/native tiering may change. This is a hypothesis, not measured native attribution.
